definitions.explanation: A target for shooting or attack, or figuratively, the object of criticism, blame, or attention.

examples.japanese: {標的|ひょうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{命中|めいちゅう}した→命中する：26978_meichuusuru⟧。
⟦いじめ→いじめ：09092_ijime⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{標的|ひょうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was made a target of bullying.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{標的|ひょうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧やすい⟦タイプ→タイプ：01534_taipu⟧だ。
examples.english: He is the type who easily becomes a target of criticism.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {標的|ひょうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become a target
- {標的|ひょうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to target, to make a target of
- ⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{標的|ひょうてき}: target of criticism
- ⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{標的|ひょうてき}: target of attack

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{的|まと}→的：19356_mato⟧: target (more colloquial; also used in archery/darts)
- ⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧: goal, objective (positive connotation; something to aim for)
- ⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧: object, subject (neutral; used for surveys, research, policies)
